# Support

Rostrum is an early self-hosted project without a paid support contract or
availability SLA.

- For evaluation and first-run help, start with the
  [judging guide](../docs/judging-guide.md).
- For configuration and operations, use the
  [deployment guide](../docs/deployment.md).
- For reproducible defects that do not contain sensitive data, open a bug
  report using the repository issue template.
- For feature proposals, open a feature request and describe the organizer or
  speaker problem before the proposed implementation.
- For project conversation, collaboration, or implementation help, contact
  [M31 Labs](https://m31labs.dev/build).
- For vulnerabilities or anything containing real event data, follow the
  [security policy](SECURITY.md) and use a private channel.

Please include the commit or `ROSTRUM_VERSION`, operating system, Go version,
storage driver, relevant redacted configuration, reproduction steps, and the
smallest safe log excerpt. Never post credentials, signed links, setup tokens,
exports, uploads, or audit records.
